column1: # peptide_gene_map.tsv - EpiProfile-PLANTS peptide sequences mapped to Arabidopsis thaliana genes
# Generated 2026-09-17. One row per (peptide sequence, protein entry, gene): 838 rows, 57 distinct sequences.
#   Four module sequences have no match in A. thaliana and no row: RYQKSTELLIR (H3_06a_53_63) and EVQTAVR,
#   IAGEASR and IASEASR (HH2BMo_03u_1_100), all mammalian sequences in modules that write no rows.
# Peptides: His.pep_seq of the peptide modules invoked with soutput = '31' in EpiProfile-PLANTS v1.1-tesis
#   (branch tesis/v1.1) and the 20 retention-time anchors of init_histone0.m. thesis_uses: matrix_274 = region
#   that writes rows to histone_ratios.xls (274 peptidoforms, 36 regions, 42 distinct sequences; H2A_1_7 lists
#   eight); invoked_module_without_rows = module called but His.display = 0; calibration_init_histone0 = anchor.
# Search: exact substring match (I and L distinct), every occurrence, in two independent sources:
#   UniProt reference proteome UP000006548 (A. thaliana Col-0), release 2026_03, FASTA with isoforms,
#   UniProt annotation TSV of the same proteome (gene names, ordered locus, family), sha256 f1f1989195abd00601a97799d334c7be53607bd7d3e876f1e397b57eed99de0c
# Cross-checks, 2026-09-17: UniProt Peptide Search (peptidesearch.uniprot.org, taxon 3702); Ensembl REST
#   /lookup/id; NCBI Gene E-utilities (TAIR symbols). Histone genes agree in all sources.
# Nomenclature: Talbert et al. 2012, Epigenetics Chromatin 5:7, PMID 22650316, Table 5 (H1, H2A, H2B, H3, H4);
#   H2B.n is the product of HTBn, not the UniProt entry name. H2B groups: Jiang et al. 2020, PLoS Genet
#   16:e1008964, PMID 32716939 (H2B.8 = H2B.S). HTR11 (AT5G65350): Ensembl/NCBI symbol. HTR7 (AT1G75610) has no
#   protein-coding model in Araport11. HTR15 = AT5G12910 is given as probable (see name_source).
# Positions: start/end_with_met1 count the initiator methionine (UniProt numbering); *_without_met1 do not.
# Digestion rule (propionylation before and after trypsin, effective Arg-C): N-terminus valid after R not
#   followed by P, or at the protein N-terminus (with or without Met1); C-terminus valid at R not followed by P
#   or at the protein C-terminus; internal R not followed by P count as missed cleavages; propionylated K are
#   not cleaved. peptide_class is computed over the histone genes whose protein releases the peptide (over the
#   genes that contain it when none does): gene-specific, shared within one variant, shared between variants.
# Gene presence is not expression: the table gives the ceiling of ambiguity, not its share in a sample.
